title: Rob Gronkowski Reveals Single Tom Brady Is On A "Hot Streak" In His Dating Life - NewsBreak
text:
By Orlando Silva ,
45 minutes ago
Alix Earle, Rob Gronkowski and Tom Brady. (Photos via Imagn Images) Tom Brady and Rob Gronkowski spent plenty of time together in the NFL. They created one of the duos in recent history, winning four championships together with the New England Patriots and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
They also developed a strong relationship off the field, and Gronk has seen firsthand Brady’s activity as he returned to dating. Following a tumultuous divorce from Gisele Bundchen, the seven-time Super Bowl winner has been linked with several high-profile names, including Irina Shayk, Sofia Vergara and Alix Earle.
Gronkowski added fuel to the rumors during a conversation with Page Six. The retired tight end picked between Brady, Julian Edelman and Mike Vrabel, going with the retired quarterback .
“But Tom is on a hot streak right now,” Gronkowski said. “He’s ready to go.”
Tom Brady Has Clear Plans Ahead Of 2026 NFL Season Tom Brady (Kirby Lee-Imagn Images) After returning to the field for the Fanatics Flag Football Classic, Tom Brady reflected on the life he wants to live now that he’s closer to his 50s. The quarterback said he would like to find more balance while maintaining his ambition.
“…The answer to the question of balance for me isn’t to do less,” Brady said. “It’s to do as much as possible around whichever priority has my attention, and then to do as much as possible to recharge my social battery so I can do it again with the next, most pressing priority.”
He has a lot in his plate for the upcoming season. Added to his job as a Fox Sports analyst, Brady has a strong voice within the Las Vegas Raiders.
